mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most common causes of conflict escalation."
Inflammatory language is one of the most common causes of conflict escalation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a long-term process that occurs after violent conflict has slowed down or come to a halt."
Peace building is a long-term process that occurs after violent conflict has slowed down or come to a halt.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a win-win outcome, giving each side as much of their interests as possible, and enough, at a minimum that they see the outcome as a win, rather than a loss."
The goal is a win-win outcome, giving each side as much of their interests as possible, and enough, at a minimum that they see the outcome as a win, rather than a loss.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the voluntary initiative of the conflicting parties to acknowledge their responsibility and guilt."
The essence of reconciliation is the voluntary initiative of the conflicting parties to acknowledge their responsibility and guilt.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process in which a neutral third party, the mediator, assists two or more parties in order to help them negotiate an agreement on a matter of common interest."
Mediation is a process in which a neutral third party, the mediator, assists two or more parties in order to help them negotiate an agreement on a matter of common interest.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the conceptions that parties have of the situation and its risks."
Frames are the conceptions that parties have of the situation and its risks.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the diplomatic effort to end the violence between the conflicting parties, move them towards nonviolent dialogue, and eventually reach a peace agreement."
Peacemaking is the diplomatic effort to end the violence between the conflicting parties, move them towards nonviolent dialogue, and eventually reach a peace agreement.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the hero of good communication."
Listening is the hero of good communication.

mutual gains approach

fourth element
